title: Vision of the Ram and Goat

questions.question: In the third year of King Belshazzar, Daniel saw a vision of a ram standing on the bank of the canal. How many horns did it have?
What animal attacked the ram?
questions.explanation: Daniel 8:5 (ESV): "behold, a male goat came from the west"

questions.question: The male goat had a conspicuous what between his eyes?
questions.explanation: Daniel 8:5 (ESV): "and the goat had a conspicuous horn between his eyes."

questions.question: Who explained the vision to Daniel?
questions.explanation: Daniel 8:16 (ESV): "And I heard a man's voice... which called, 'Gabriel, make this man understand the vision.'"

questions.question: The two-horned ram represents the kings of what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 8:20 (ESV): "As for the ram that you saw with the two horns, these are the kings of Media and Persia."

questions.question: When the great horn was broken, what came up in its place?
options: Four conspicuous horns toward the four winds of heaven
questions.correctAnswer: Four conspicuous horns toward the four winds of heaven
questions.explanation: Daniel 8:8 (ESV): "But when he was strong, the great horn was broken, and instead of it there came up four conspicuous horns toward the four winds of heaven."

questions.question: Out of one of the four horns came a little horn which grew exceedingly great toward the south, the east, and the what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 8:9 (ESV): "which grew exceedingly great toward the south, toward the east, and toward the glorious land."

questions.question: The goat represents the king of what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 8:21 (ESV): "And the goat is the king of Greece."

questions.question: How long would the vision of the regular burnt offering and the transgression that makes desolate last?
questions.explanation: Daniel 8:14 (ESV): "And he said to me, 'For 2,300 evenings and mornings. Then the sanctuary shall be restored to its rightful state.'"

questions.question: A king of bold face will arise who shall destroy whom?
options: Mighty men and the people who are the saints
questions.correctAnswer: Mighty men and the people who are the saints
questions.explanation: Daniel 8:24 (ESV): "and shall destroy mighty men and the people who are the saints."

questions.question: By no human hand, this king shall be what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 8:25 (ESV): "and by no human hand he shall be broken."

questions.question: What was Daniel's physical reaction to the vision?
options: He was overcome and lay sick for some days
questions.correctAnswer: He was overcome and lay sick for some days
questions.explanation: Daniel 8:27 (ESV): "And I, Daniel, was overcome and lay sick for some days."

questions.question: The vision refers to the time of the what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 8:17 (ESV): "Understand, O son of man, that the vision is for the time of the end."

questions.question: The ram had one horn higher than the other, and the higher one came up when?
questions.explanation: Daniel 8:3 (ESV): "and the higher one came up last."

questions.question: Why was Daniel told to seal up the vision?
options: For it refers to many days from now
So no one could read it
questions.correctAnswer: For it refers to many days from now
questions.explanation: Daniel 8:26 (ESV): "but seal up the vision, for it refers to many days from now."

key_verse_text: So he came near where I stood. And when he came, I was frightened and fell on my face. But he said to me, "Understand, O son of man, that the vision is for the time of the end."
